primary.title: Mozart's Letters, Mozart's Life: Selected Letters
primary.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
primary.rationale: A collection of letters offering direct insight into Mozart's life, thoughts, and professional activities. Many of his letters are preserved and have been published.

primary.title: The Letters of Mozart and His Family
primary.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
primary.rationale: This comprehensive collection includes correspondence from Mozart and his family, providing a rich tapestry of their lives and the musical world of the era. Early letters are particularly valuable.

primary.title: Autobiographical Notes
primary.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
primary.rationale: Mozart's own brief autobiographical notes, though limited, offer a personal perspective on his early life and career. These are often included in collections of his writings.

secondary.title: Mozart: A Life
secondary.author: Paul Johnson
secondary.rationale: A well-regarded biographical account by a prominent historian, offering a comprehensive overview of Mozart's life and work.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Mozart Encyclopedia
secondary.author: Clifford Bartlett
secondary.rationale: A scholarly encyclopedia providing in-depth articles on various aspects of Mozart's life, music, and contemporaries, written by experts in the field.

secondary.title: Mozart's Operas
secondary.author: David Cairns
secondary.rationale: A critical analysis of Mozart's operatic works, offering scholarly insights into their composition, performance, and historical context.

suggestions.notes: Primary source materials for Mozart primarily consist of his extensive correspondence and some personal writings. Availability on digital platforms like Internet Archive is high for published collections of these letters. Secondary sources are abundant, with many scholarly biographies and analyses published since 1976.
